title: pnpm dev silently reuses an already-running Marinara on PORT 7860
skill_evidence: SKILL.md:423 'Normal install — your day-to-day Marinara... (7820 instead of the default 7860)'; SKILL.md:337 'Reproduce on the user's local dev install (`pnpm dev` running)'; SKILL.md:579 'Dev URLs: client at http://localhost:5173, server at http://localhost:7860'
reality: scripts/dev.mjs:13-14 reads PORT from the shell env only (default 7860); dev.mjs:150-167 probes /api/health and, if any healthy Marinara answers, logs 'already running... Reusing it and starting the client' and never starts the checkout's server (#5062, 2.4.3). packages/client/vite.config.ts:188 proxies /api to the same PORT. So with the daily-driver install on 7860 (the setup the skill recommends), `pnpm dev` starts only the client, which talks to the daily-driver's server build and real data; the contributor's server changes are not running.
fix: SKILL.md Mode B, 'Recommended test setup' (after the 'Two servers must never share one data folder' paragraph) and §2: add 'pnpm dev reuses any healthy Marinara already listening on PORT (default 7860) and starts only the client. Stop the daily-driver install first, or run the dev checkout on another port by setting PORT in the shell (e.g. `$env:PORT=7870; pnpm dev`). dev.mjs and the Vite proxy read the shell variable, not the repo .env. Check the [dev] log line: "Reusing it" means your server code is not the one running.'

title: What CI runs omits the full Node regression lane on every PR, and smoke runs only for PRs into staging
skill_evidence: SKILL.md:585 'The required `pnpm-validate` PR check runs `pnpm check`, the `launcher-update`, `security`, and `release` regressions, version and installer guards, the @smoke Chromium suite, and `smoke:production` on desktop Chromium'
reality: .github/workflows/playwright.yml ('Regression Checks', on pull_request to [staging, main] and push to staging) job `complete-node-regressions` (:59-90) runs the whole `pnpm regression` lane on every PR. CONTRIBUTING.md:143: 'Pull requests and staging pushes retain this complete lane on a hosted runner.' pull-request-checks.yml:64-79 runs the @smoke suite and `smoke:production --project=desktop-chromium` only when `github.base_ref == 'staging'`. Staging pushes run it as `browser-smoke` (playwright.yml:92-98). pnpm-validate also runs `scripts/validate-pr-triage.mjs` and `scripts/test-owner-approval.mjs` (:50-54).
fix: SKILL.md 'What CI runs': add 'A separate Regression Checks workflow runs the complete Node regression lane (`pnpm regression`) on every PR and staging push, so a regression anywhere in the suite fails CI, not only the three lanes inside pnpm-validate.' Also note that the smoke and production-smoke steps apply to PRs into `staging`; PRs into `main` get the full matrix instead.

title: Dual-install robocopy mirrors the in-repo pnpm store and .dev-mcp state
skill_evidence: SKILL.md:439 'robocopy ... /MIR /XF teststart.bat /XD node_modules .git .claude ...'; SKILL.md:447 'node_modules (installed locally per dir)'
reality: The tracked .npmrc sets `store-dir=.pnpm-store` and `virtual-store-dir=.pnpm`, so dependencies live in the repo-root folders `.pnpm/` and `.pnpm-store/` (both gitignored, .gitignore:7-8). Excluding only node_modules makes /MIR copy the dev checkout's whole virtual store and package store into the test dir. It also copies `.dev-mcp/` (card backups and prompt copies, tools/dev-mcp/README.md:99) and `.tmp/` (Playwright data).
fix: SKILL.md:439: change the exclusions to `/XD node_modules .pnpm .pnpm-store .git .claude .dev-mcp .tmp`, and list `.pnpm`/`.pnpm-store`/`.dev-mcp` in the 'must NEVER touch' line at :447.
